_source: KZN DARD 'Plant Establishment' (Vegetable production guide), Table 6 'Sowing times for certain selected vegetable crops': https://www.kzndard.gov.za/images/Documents/Horticulture/Veg_prod/plant_establishment.pdf — the same table already cited in lib/crop-catalog.ts's FROST_FREE_CALENDAR_CITED comment for the 8 already-cited crops. 'months' = the table's 'Hot areas Frost-free' column (maps to catalog 'all-year'); 'mildFrost' = the table's 'Warm areas Light frosts' column (maps to catalog 'mild-frost'). Where a range gives an ambiguous slash endpoint (e.g. 'Feb - Jun/Jul'), the ambiguous alternative is excluded, matching this catalog's existing convention (see the carrots/turnip in-code comments already doing this).

evidence.quote: Sweet corn Sept/Oct - Dec Aug/Sept - Jan/Feb Jan - Mar, Jul - Sept
evidence.doc: KZN DARD 'Plant Establishment', Table 6, Sweet corn row

maize.note: PROXY, not an exact match: this catalog entry is grain maize (mielies, dried ~120-140 days), but Table 6 has no separate maize/mielie row — only 'Sweet corn'. Same species (Zea mays), same frost-tenderness and soil-temperature sowing trigger, so the window is a defensible physiological proxy, but not a maize-specific citation. Both slash ends of the mild-frost range ('Aug/Sept' and 'Jan/Feb') are ambiguous; kept only the shared Sept-Jan core. DAFF/DALRRD's grain-maize production guideline (already cited elsewhere in this catalog for days-to-harvest) could give a maize-specific regional planting table, but web.archive.org was intermittently 'Temporarily Offline' during this pass and the guideline's exact filename could not be found on nda.gov.za (which blocks direct fetches) — worth a follow-up. Current catalog's all-year [10,11,12] and mild-frost [10,11,12] share no months at all with this source's frost-free window, which is the most striking disagreement found in this pass.

dry-beans.note: Table 6 only has one 'Bean, bush' row — it does not split dry (sugar) beans from green/snap beans, so this same row is used for both catalog crops below. Frost-free range taken as Feb-Sept (unambiguous). Warm/light-frost range 'Aug - Feb/Mar': ambiguous Mar end excluded, kept Aug-Feb. Current catalog's all-year [3,4] is far narrower than the source's Feb-Sept and barely overlaps (only March); its mild-frost [11,12,1] falls almost entirely outside the source's Aug-Feb window (Nov, Dec, Jan) but the source's own core Aug-Oct is absent from the catalog.

green-beans.note: Same shared 'Bean, bush' row as dry-beans (Table 6 does not distinguish green/snap from dry beans) — see that entry's caveat. Current catalog's all-year keeps Oct-Nov beyond the source's Feb-Sept ceiling and is missing the source's May-Jul core; mild-frost is close but not identical (missing Aug and Feb from the source window).

evidence.quote: Cucurbits Sept - Dec/Jan Aug - Jan/Feb Mar - May, Jul - Oct
evidence.doc: KZN DARD 'Plant Establishment', Table 6, Cucurbits row

butternut.note: Table 6 lumps butternut, pumpkin, cucumber, watermelon (and squash/marrow/melon) under one blanket 'Cucurbits' row rather than naming each species, so this is a coarse family-level proxy, not a butternut-specific citation — treat with lower confidence than the other rows here. Frost-free ambiguous end 'Jan' excluded from the Sept-Dec/Jan cold-area range (not used); the Frost-free column itself, 'Mar - May, Jul - Oct', has no ambiguity. Warm/light-frost 'Aug - Jan/Feb': ambiguous Feb end excluded. Current catalog's Aug-Nov window for both all-year and mild-frost barely overlaps this source's split Mar-May/Jul-Oct frost-free window (only Aug-Oct in common) and its mild-frost differs by several months at each end.

cucumber.note: Same blanket 'Cucurbits' row — cucumber (~60-70 days) matures far faster than butternut/pumpkin (~110-130 days), so one shared sowing window for the whole family is a real weakness of this source, not just a citation nuance. Mild-frost is the closest overlap of the four cucurbits (Sept-Dec in common) but still not an exact match.

potato.note: The catalog's existing in-code comment already quotes this exact 'April/May' frost-free cell and folds it into the wider all-year array together with a separate 'potato-specific bulletin' (uncited here) that adds Feb, Mar, Jul, Aug, Sep — so the catalog's all-year is a deliberate blend of two sources, not an error, but on this table alone the frost-free months are only Apr-May. Mild-frost ('June-August') does not match the catalog's [1,8,9,10] — the catalog's mild-frost is sourced from the same potato-specific bulletin's Aug-Oct-plus-Jan figure instead of this table's Jun-Aug, per its own in-code comment.

evidence.quote: Bean, broad Apr - May Apr - May Apr - May
evidence.doc: KZN DARD 'Plant Establishment', Table 6, Bean, broad row

broad-beans.note: All three columns identical (Apr-May); mild-frost already matches the catalog's existing cited value exactly (its own in-code comment already cites this table). All-year does not match: the catalog's much wider [2..8] reflects broad beans' distinct overwintering hardiness (per the catalog's own note on frost tolerance) rather than this table's frost-free cell, so the disagreement looks like a deliberate widening for a genuinely frost-tolerant legume, not an uncited error — but it is still not what this source's frost-free column itself says.

uncitable.kale: No row for kale in this table, and the catalog's own in-code comment (dated 2026-08-23) already records that it checked all five KZN DARD vegetable-production tables (expected yields, plant establishment, length of growing period, successional cropping, populations/spacings) plus the DALRRD leafy-vegetables brochure and the GDARD vegetable guideline, and kale is absent from every one — confirmed again here, not re-litigated with a new fetch.
uncitable.groundnuts: No groundnut row in KZN DARD Table 6 (a legume/oilseed crop, not a vegetable this table covers). Attempted DAFF/DALRRD's dedicated groundnut production guideline (nda.gov.za blocks direct fetches; tried via web.archive.org with the brief's id_ pattern and several guessed filenames) and grainsa.co.za/arc.agric.za directly, but web.archive.org returned 'Temporarily Offline' or 404 on every attempt during this pass and the exact DAFF filename could not be located from a CDX listing (archive.org's CDX endpoint was also unreachable/incomplete). A retry once archive.org is stable, or a direct DAFF/ARC-GCI groundnut guideline URL, would likely resolve this.
uncitable.coriander: No coriander/dhania row in KZN DARD Table 6. The catalog's own in-code note already records that coriander/dhania is not a line item in the KZN DARD Expected Yields table either, and that the only SA-adjacent figures found (Kenyan commercial dhania seed yields) are for a different product (dried seed, not fresh leaf) and region. No DAFF herb-specific production guideline covering warm/frost-free sowing months for coriander was located in this pass.
uncitable.oats: No oats row in KZN DARD Table 6 (a vegetable-sowing table; oats here is a non-food winter cover crop for maize land, sourced elsewhere in the catalog from a separate 'forage-cereal bulletin'). That forage-cereal bulletin's own window (mid-Feb to early May) is not broken out by frost-free/warm/cool area the way Table 6 is, so a genuinely frost-free-area-specific oats sowing window was not found in this pass.
